(11)  Where  any  registered  elephant  dies,  the

(12) Any elephant which has not been registered
under  this  section  shall  be  presumed  to  be  taken
or removed from the wild without lawful authority
or approval and such elephants shall be deemed to
be public property. The provisions of the Offences
Against Public Property Act, No. 12 of 1982 shall
accordingly apply in respect of such elephants.”.
